British Columbia has adopted permanent year-round daylight saving time (Pacific Time), with the change scheduled to take effect on November 1. We recognize that some community members may have questions about the impact on calendars, devices, and scheduled meetings.

UBC IT is actively working with Microsoft and Apple to coordinate the required time zone updates for computers, mobile devices, and calendaring services. We anticipate updates from our vendors will begin rolling out next week.

UBC IT plans to provide detailed guidance by October 16 outlining what to expect and any actions that may be required.
Thank you for your patience as we work to ensure a smooth transition.

incidents.name: Wireless connectivity issues for Macs - November 4, 2026 - 13:00 PT

incident_updates.body:
After investigating, UBC IT technicians have determined that a recent required network upgrade resulted in some older devices being unable to connect to UBC's networks. UBC's wireless network remains fully functional, and most up-to-date devices are able to connect.

We strongly recommend that all clients ensure their devices are up to date with the latest versions of their operating system. For Macs this is MacOS 27.2.1, and for iPhone/iPad this is iOS version 27.2.1.

If your phone or computer is unable to update to the latest version, clients may opt to use the UBC IoT network as an alternative, if connecting from on-campus. More information about the IoT network can be found at https://it.ubc.ca/services/email-voice-internet/ubc-internet-things-iot-wi-fi.

Noted workarounds appear to be working for affected users.
Technicians are still monitoring the issue; however, recommendation is to apply one of the workarounds/fixes.

Issue is still being investigated.

For workarounds:

1. Update your MacOS operating system
2. Use the UBCIoT Wifi network (https://it.ubc.ca/services/email-voice-internet/ubc-internet-things-iot-wi-fi)

There is currently an issue that some Mac devices are unable to connect to the UBC wireless networks.

Technicians are investigating the issue.

Next update will be at 15:00

incidents.name: View My Teaching Schedule report in Workday not showing teaching assignments

incident_updates.body: This issue is still ongoing. We apologize for the inconvenience. Please continue reaching out to the Integrated Service Centre for questions and support.

Faculty are unable to view their current or upcoming teaching assignments when using the View My Teaching Schedule report in Workday. The issue is being investigated. In the meantime, when running the View My Teaching Schedule report in Workday to view teaching assignments, search for the specific academic period in the 'Academic Period' field. For example, for 2026 Winter Term 1, type in "2026 Winter" and press 'Enter'. Select from the academic period options. Select 'OK'. Please reach out to the Integrated Service Centre for questions and support.

incidents.name: Microsoft announces removal of Office support for older systems and software versions, July 13, 2026

incident_updates.body:
Microsoft has announced that effective July 13th, 2026, Office applications will no longer be supported on older MacOS and iOS systems, and further, they are removing support for older versions of Office entirely. 
 
	• Clients which are running operating systems earlier than the following minimums will no longer be able to edit or save files after the change: 
		Mac OS – minimum version 12.0 (Monterey) 
		iOS – minimum version 17.0 
 
	• Clients who are using Office 2019 for Mac, regardless of operating system, will be unable to edit or save files after the change. 
	• Clients who are using Office 2021 for Mac or MS 365 apps on iPhone and iPads will continue to function normally, provided the operating systems are supported (as listed above) and at the following minimum software versions: 
		Office 2021 for Mac – minimum version 16.83 
		MS365 apps for iOS – minimum version 2.93 
 
UBC IT strongly recommends that all clients running Office on a Mac, iPhone, or iPad  update their operating systems and Office software before July 13th to prevent any disruptions. 
 
For more information, see https://ubc.service-now.com/kb_view.do?sysparm_article=KB0020043

scheduled_maintenances.name: BC time zone change for UBC managed MacOS devices October 20, 2026, 16:00 PT

incident_updates.body: Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.

UBC IT will be preparing end user devices for the transition to the new BC time zone (PCT, UTC -7:00).  MacOS devices that are currently set to America/Los_Angeles, America/Tijuana or US/Pacific (PST/PDT) will be transitioned to America/Vancouver to address the new time zone for British Columbia.  We realize this may impact a small number of devices operating outside BC (Washington, Oregon, California) that may need to be corrected after this change.
